# Chapter 1 — The Dagger

The cliffs of [[Stormholm]] glittered at dawn. Aerin stood at the eastern
parapet, her green eyes searching the horizon for the ship her aunt had
promised would come.

In the harbor below, the fishermen were already at work, their voices small
against the wind. She tightened her grip on the dagger at her belt — black
iron, heavier than any blade she had carried.
